mission.original_ambition: Choose a rehearsal inventory bundle with greatest total recovery points. At most three distinct items and 11 kilograms fit. Optic weighs 5 and gives 11 points, mount weighs 2 and gives 2, torch weighs 3 and gives 8, gauge weighs 4 and gives 9, bag weighs 1 and gives 3, and seal weighs 2 and gives 1. An optic requires the mount. A torch and gauge are incompatible in the same bundle. Give the optimal manifest and independently check why nothing better fits. Create a reusable small tool or computational receipt that can run on a different catalog. These are planning points, not prices.
